newsitem.title: MEXICO: Eight Mexicans die from breathing sulfuric acid.
newsitem.headline: Eight Mexicans die from breathing sulfuric acid.

text.p: Eight people died in a city in central Mexico died from breathing sulphuric acid in a hide tanning shop, authorities said on Saturday.
The victims, eight men aged 24 to 35, died on Friday night in city of Cuautla in Morelos state just south of Mexico City, the government news agency Notimex reported, citing Morelos state officials.
The bodies were found on Saturday by a security guard at the Temaula Tanning store, Notimex said. All eight apparently worked at the store.
State authorities have opened a criminal investigation.
